title: Abamenya Endagaano Abawaŋŋanguse
intro: Mu nnaku ezaasooka ez’ekitundu ekipya, ekika edda kyali kibeera mu mayumba ag’ebigo, nga kisibiddwa ku ndagaano. Endagaano eyo bwe yalyamu olukwe, ebyavaamu byawulikika mu mpapula za Quran. Abantu bano baali baani, era kiki ekyatuuka ku maka gaabwe n’ensuku zaabwe?
clues: Twabeeranga mu bigo ebyatuwa obukuumi obw’obulimba.
Twali bantu ba Byawandiikibwa, naye ne tumenya endagaano yaffe.
Twakola olukwe ku mubaka ng’amaze okujja gye tuli, naye olukwe lwaffe ne lulemererwa.
Enkindu zaffe zaatemebwa ku kiragiro kya Allah, akabonero k’amaanyi ge.
Twagobwa mu maka gaffe, nga tetuddayo, ng’ekibonerezo olw’okujeemera kwaffe.
Quran etuyogerako mu ssuula y’okukung’aana, era emboozi yaffe ekola ng’okulabula eri abo abamenya endagaano.
arabic: مَا قَطَعْتُم مِّن لِّينَةٍ أَوْ تَرَكْتُمُوهَا قَآئِمَةً عَلَىٰٓ أُصُولِهَا فَبِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِيُخْزِىَ ٱلْفَـٰسِقِينَ
verse: Whatever you have cut down of [their] palm trees or left standing on their trunks - it was by permission of Allāh and so He would disgrace the defiantly disobedient. (59:5)
